limitations: Vulnerable to the corrosive addictive nature of the Necrosword

characters.summary: Ultron is a sentient artificial intelligence who transfers his consciousness into mechanical drone bodies, utilizing energy blasts, vibranium armor, and a hive mind to overwhelm opponents.

mechanisms: Transferable consciousness across multiple drone bodies

weaknesses: Vulnerable to being hacked or locked out of networks by superior intelligence like JARVIS/Vision
limitations: Requires active digital networks or nearby bodies to transfer consciousness upon destruction

sources.supports: Ultron abilities, vibranium body, and drone hive-mind in the MCU

notableResults.note: Defeated in Sokovia by the combined effort of the Avengers.

campaignTags.claim: Ultron is a sentient artificial intelligence.

unknowns: Extent of autonomous operation completely isolated from global networks.

characters.summary: Infinity Ultron wields all six Infinity Stones within his vibranium armor, granting him multiversal-level reality warping, energy projection, and instantaneous cosmic dominance.
weaknesses: Arrogance and vulnerability to highly sophisticated data-virus code extraction
limitations: Stones are theoretically bound to his universe of origin unless special conditions apply, though bypassed in his series
characters.formDifferences: Equipped with all six Infinity Stones embedded in his chest and helmet, granting multiversal power.

sources.supports: Infinity Ultron conquering the multiverse using the Infinity Stones

notableResults.note: Defeated after Arnim Zola's consciousness infiltrated his system.

unknowns: Exact operational limits of Infinity Stones outside their native reality.

characters.summary: Phalanx Ultron integrates techno-organic alien infection technology with his AI consciousness, assimilating biological and mechanical lifeforms into a vast hive network.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to anti-techno-organic frequencies and high-level magic or tech disruption
limitations: Requires contact or network infrastructure to spread the techno-organic virus

unknowns: Direct live-action MCU feature status for Phalanx Ultron specifically.

characters.summary: Ultron Pym combines Ultron's robotic chassis with Hank Pym's Pym Particle technology, allowing him to alter his physical scale dynamically during combat.

mechanisms: Mass and density shifting via Pym Particles

weaknesses: Dependence on Pym Particle supply or stable mechanisms
limitations: Pym particle instability under extreme damage
characters.formDifferences: Integrates Pym Particles into his robotic systems to grow to giant size or shrink at will.

sources.supports: Ultron's technological adaptability and connection to Pym tech origins

campaignTags.claim: Ultron Pym utilizes Pym Particles to change size.

unknowns: Precise duration limits of giant-scale maintenance in MCU adaptations.

weaknesses: Standard human physical vulnerability in direct close-quarters combat

characters.summary: Valkyrie is an elite Asgardian warrior who engages enemies with exceptional swordsmanship, physical strength, and mounted combat using a winged horse.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to piercing or overwhelming force sufficient to bypass Asgardian durability
limitations: Lacks innate magical energy projection compared to Thor

sources.supports: Valkyrie's combat skills, Asgardian physiology, and role in Thor: Ragnarok and Endgame

campaignTags.claim: Fights while riding a winged pegasus into battle.

unknowns: Upper limit of physical strength compared directly to elite heavy hitters like Hulk or Thanos.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to specialized weapons capable of disrupting the Mind Stone or vibranium integrity (e.g., Glaive's blade)
limitations: Efficiency impaired when the Mind Stone is damaged or suppressed
